roleDetail.owner: Full control including billing, plan and ownership transfer.
roleDetail.admin: Manages people, teams and workspace configuration. Cannot change billing.
roleDetail.profileLead: Owns their clients end to end — submits, approves and invoices.
roleDetail.recruiter: Works assigned requisitions. Sends submissions up for approval.
roleDetail.sourcer: Sourcing only. Cannot submit, reject, or see fees.
